# SC2014: conflicting-injection-flags

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for conflicting injection flags. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Choose @Self() or @SkipSelf() for each parameter. Different parameters may use different modifiers for the same token.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC2014` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC2014
@Injectable() class Consumer {
  constructor(@Self() @SkipSelf() @Inject(PORT) readonly port: string) {}
}
```
